stock_dtbo.explanation: AOSP AVB build replaces the stock footer; full-image hash equality is not required.

recovery_cpio.extraction: CPIO parsed in memory; selected regular files copied only; no archive symlinks/devices materialized

first_stage.fix: Stage first-stage fstab under TARGET_COPY_OUT_ROOT so recovery-as-boot includes it.
first_stage.init_layout: /init points to /system/bin/init; recovery init and linker dependencies exist in the ramdisk. FirstStageMain mounts system before its next exec; no separate first_stage_ramdisk init/linker is required.

pstore.design: Pstore modules loaded explicitly by vendor r1-expdb after post-fs; recovery image does not load them.
pstore.note: These targets do not install the vendor pstore modules. Expected vendor/lib/modules installation rules exist; staged module hashes match the pinned kernel. Eventual vendor image contents remain unverified.

lk_mode_handoff.scope: Bounded binary instruction replay of mode dispatch and command-line append only
lk_mode_handoff.modeled: Single-thread CPU critical-section enter/exit return; no loader, partition access, firmware authentication, peripheral or full boot execution
lk_mode_handoff.conclusion: LK appends force_normal_boot=1 in normal mode and omits it in recovery; the relevant code and string are unchanged by current LK patches. Do not add the token unconditionally to the boot header.

limitations: AVB integrity/self-signature checks do not establish a trusted key or a complete vbmeta chain. --flags 3 configures top-level vbmeta, not boot/DTBO footers.

Bounded stock/patched LK instruction replay confirms mode 0 appends androidboot.force_normal_boot=1 and mode 2 omits it. This establishes the intended normal/recovery handoff logic, not whole-loader execution or hardware boot.
Current product boot arguments request global permissive SELinux mode. Policy analysis below checks per-domain declarations only.

No image contents are executed; no drivers, modules, devices, APKs or partitions are loaded or accessed.
